long_biography.plain_text:
VPK began as a Belgian paper mill acquired by Pierre Ivan Rene Macharis's grandfather. When the third generation took charge, Macharis helped shift the enterprise beyond its domestic base. The family floated the company to finance overseas purchases, then took it private again after the expansion gained momentum.

Today, the group links recycled-paper production with corrugated and solid-board packaging across Europe. Macharis remains its chief executive, managing director and a member of the shareholder family. His long tenure combines responsibility for the established family platform with the acquisition-led growth that reshaped it.
